- Committed start: target go-live Oct 15, 2027; pilot window Sept 20–Oct 10.
- Security/ops notes: Manoa requires Okta SSO, VPC peering (single-tenant network), and 45-day payment terms. SOC2 evidence requested in procurement thread (cc'd).
- Key contacts: Elena Park (product), Procurement (procurement@manoahealth.com).

1) Confirm sequencing for pilot and go-live (pilot scope + acceptance criteria).
2) Assign primary onboarding owner and implementation PM.
3) Confirm one technical kickoff date (propose Aug 30 or Sep 3).

Hi team — thanks for the clear summary. Answers below: 

- Pilot acceptance: 1) median response latency < 400ms for 95th percentile, 2) generation error/failure < 0.5% (we'll share sample traffic), 3) product sign-off after two-week review with pilot users (qualitative).
- PHI: No PHI in initial scope — only de-identified patient messages and engagement content; we will confirm routing later for any escalations.
- Network: we prefer VPC peering with static IPs for the first 90 days while we validate. Procurement will coordinate firewall rules.
- SSO: we'll send Okta SP metadata by Aug 26.
- Payment terms: Procurement requesting standard 45-day invoice terms — their contact is cc'd.

Technical kickoff Aug 30 at 10am PT works for Product and Eng. For the pilot we'll expect weekly 30-minute check-ins.
